## Load libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)

```

## Load data

```{r}

tcgaDataDir <- "data/TCGA"

# Mount TCGA bucket if it isn't already mounted
if(length(list.files(tcgaDataDir)) == 0) system("axe-cloud-fuser mount --path buckets.yaml")

# Define TCGA studies of interest
# SOI <- c("LAML", "LGG", "GBM", "PAAD", "COADREAD", "HNSC", "ESCA", "DLBC", "BRCA", "LUAD", "LUSC", "PRAD", "SARC")
SOI <- c("LAML", "LGG", "GBM", "PAAD", "COADREAD", "HNSC", "ESCA", "BRCA", "LUAD", "LUSC")

# Define types of mutations to remove
mut_to_remove <- c("3'Flank", "3'UTR", "5'Flank", "5'UTR", "IGR", "Intron", "RNA", "Silent")

# Define damaging mutations
damaging_mut <- c("Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Translation_Start_Site", "Splice_Region", "Splice_Site")

all_ind <- list()
ind_cases <- list()

for(ind in list.files(tcgaDataDir, pattern = "_tcga$"))
{
    
    if(ind != "luad_tcga" & ind %in% paste(tolower(SOI), "tcga", sep = "_"))
    {
        all_ind[[ind]] <- read_tsv(file.path(tcgaDataDir, ind, "data_mutations.txt")) %>%
                            select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol, Entrez_Gene_Id,
                                   Variant_Classification, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele1, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
                                   HGVSc, HGVSp_Short, Hotspot) %>%
                            filter(!Variant_Classification %in% mut_to_remove) %>%
                            mutate(Damaging = ifelse(Variant_Classification %in% damaging_mut, 1, 0),
                                   ProjectID = paste0("TCGA-", toupper(str_extract(ind, "[^_]+"))))

        ind_cases[[ind]] <- data.frame(ProjectID = paste0("TCGA-", toupper(str_extract(ind, "[^_]+"))),
                                       Tumor_Sample_Barcode = unlist(lapply(str_split(readLines(pipe(paste0("grep 'case_list_ids' ", tcgaDataDir, "/", ind, "/case_lists/cases_sequenced.txt"))), "\t"), function(x) gsub("case_list_ids: ", "", x))))
        
    } else if(ind == "luad_tcga")
    {
        all_ind[[ind]] <- read_tsv(file.path(tcgaDataDir, ind, "data_mutations_mskcc.txt")) %>%
                            select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol, Entrez_Gene_Id,
                                   Variant_Classification, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele1, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
                                   HGVSc, HGVSp_Short, Hotspot) %>%
                            filter(!Variant_Classification %in% mut_to_remove) %>%
                            mutate(Damaging = ifelse(Variant_Classification %in% damaging_mut, 1, 0),
                                   ProjectID = paste0("TCGA-", toupper(str_extract(ind, "[^_]+"))))
        
        ind_cases[[ind]] <- data.frame(ProjectID = paste0("TCGA-", toupper(str_extract(ind, "[^_]+"))),
                                       Tumor_Sample_Barcode = unlist(lapply(str_split(readLines(pipe(paste0("grep 'case_list_ids' ", tcgaDataDir, "/", ind, "/case_lists/cases_sequenced.txt"))), "\t"), function(x) gsub("case_list_ids: ", "", x))))
        
    }
    
}

all_dat <- do.call("bind_rows", all_ind)
ind_mtdt <- do.call("bind_rows", ind_cases)

# rm(all_ind)
invisible(gc())
die
```

## Organize data

```{r}

# Organize metadata
ind_mtdt %<>% separate(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, into = c("a", "b", "c", "Sample_Type"), sep = "-") %>%
                mutate(Sample_Type = case_when(Sample_Type %in% c("06", "07") ~ "Metastatic", .default = "Primary"),
                       PatientID = paste(a, b, c, sep = "-")) %>% select(-c(a, b, c))

ind_summ <- ind_mtdt %>% filter(Sample_Type != "Metastatic") %>%
                            group_by(ProjectID) %>%
                            summarise(num_patients = length(unique(PatientID))) %>%
                            ungroup() %>%
                            as.data.frame()

# Add descriptive cancer type names
ind_summ %<>% mutate(ProjectName = case_when(ProjectID == "TCGA-BRCA" ~ "Breast Invasive Carcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-COADREAD" ~ "Colorectal Adenocarcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-ESCA" ~ "Esophageal Carcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-GBM" ~ "Glioblastoma Multiforme",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-HNSC" ~ "Head & Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-LAML" ~ "Acute Myeloid Leukemia",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-LGG" ~ "Brain Lower Grade Glioma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-LUAD" ~ "Lung Adenocarcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-LUSC" ~ "Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
                                             ProjectID == "TCGA-PAAD" ~ "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma")) %>%
                select(ProjectID, ProjectName, num_patients)

ind_summ %<>% bind_rows(data.frame(ProjectID = "All Indications", ProjectName = "All Indications", num_patients = sum(ind_summ$num_patients)))


# Get patient IDs and tumor types
all_dat %<>% separate(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, into = c("a", "b", "c", "Sample_Type"), sep = "-") %>%
                mutate(PatientID = paste(a, b, c, sep = "-")) %>% select(-c(a, b, c)) %>%
                rename(ProteinChange = HGVSp_Short)

# Separate metastatic tumors (06 = metastatic)
# met <- all_dat %>% filter(Sample_Type == "06")

# Remove metastatic tumors from data set
all_dat %<>% filter(Sample_Type != "06")

# Collapse data to the patient/mutation level
all_dat_coll <- all_dat %>% group_by(PatientID, ProjectID, Hugo_Symbol, HGVSc, ProteinChange) %>%
                            summarise(across(everything(), ~paste(unique(.), collapse = ";")))

rm(all_dat)
invisible(gc())

```

## Calculate mutation frequency

```{r}

# Get prevalence at the mutation level
gene_mut_summ <- all_dat_coll %>% group_by(ProjectID, Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                                    summarise(all_HGVSc = paste(unique(HGVSc), collapse = ";"),
                                              num_patients_with_mutation = length(unique(PatientID))) %>%
                                    ungroup() %>%
                                    left_join(ind_summ, by = "ProjectID") %>%
                                    mutate(pct_patients_with_mutation = round(num_patients_with_mutation/num_patients*100, digits = 1)) %>%
                                    arrange(desc(pct_patients_with_mutation), desc(num_patients_with_mutation)) %>%
                                    as.data.frame()

# Get prevalence across all cancer types
pancan_gene_mut_summ <- gene_mut_summ %>% group_by(Hugo_Symbol, all_HGVSc, ProteinChange) %>%
                                            summarise(num_patients_with_mutation = sum(num_patients_with_mutation, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                                            ungroup() %>%
                                            mutate(ProjectID = "All Indications") %>%
                                            left_join(ind_summ, by = "ProjectID") %>%
                                            mutate(pct_patients_with_mutation = round(num_patients_with_mutation/num_patients*100, digits = 1)) %>%
                                            arrange(desc(pct_patients_with_mutation), desc(num_patients_with_mutation)) %>%
                                            as.data.frame()

# Get prevalence of individual missense mutations and combined truncating mutations
tmp_dam <- all_dat_coll %>% filter(Damaging == 1) %>%
                            mutate(orig_ProteinChange = ProteinChange,
                                   ProteinChange = "Damaging_Mutation") %>%
                            group_by(ProjectID, Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                            summarise(all_damaging_mut_ProteinChange = paste(unique(orig_ProteinChange), collapse = ";"),
                                      all_HGVSc = paste(unique(HGVSc), collapse = ";"),
                                      num_patients_with_mutation = length(unique(PatientID))) %>%
                            ungroup()

tmp_mut <- all_dat_coll %>% filter(Damaging != 1) %>%
                            group_by(ProjectID, Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                            summarise(all_HGVSc = paste(unique(HGVSc), collapse = ";"),
                                      num_patients_with_mutation = length(unique(PatientID))) %>%
                            ungroup()

gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ <- bind_rows(tmp_dam, tmp_mut) %>%
                                left_join(ind_summ, by = "ProjectID") %>%
                                mutate(pct_patients_with_mutation = round(num_patients_with_mutation/num_patients*100, digits = 1)) %>%
                                arrange(desc(pct_patients_with_mutation), desc(num_patients_with_mutation), Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange, ProjectID) %>%
                                as.data.frame()

# Get prevalence across all cancer types
pancan_gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ <- gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ %>% group_by(Hugo_Symbol, all_damaging_mut_ProteinChange, all_HGVSc, ProteinChange) %>%
                                                                    summarise(num_patients_with_mutation = sum(num_patients_with_mutation, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                                                                    ungroup() %>%
                                                                    mutate(ProjectID = "All Indications") %>%
                                                                    left_join(ind_summ, by = "ProjectID") %>%
                                                                    mutate(pct_patients_with_mutation = round(num_patients_with_mutation/num_patients*100, digits = 1)) %>%
                                                                    arrange(desc(pct_patients_with_mutation), desc(num_patients_with_mutation)) %>%
                                                                    as.data.frame()

rm("tmp_dam", "tmp_mut")

```

## Load DepMap data

```{r}

depmapDataDir <- "data/DMC_25Q2"

# Load DepMap somatic mutations
dmc_mut <- read_csv(file.path(depmapDataDir, "OmicsSomaticMutations.csv")) %>%
            select(ModelID, HugoSymbol, DNAChange, ProteinChange, VariantType, VariantInfo)

# Load DepMap metadata
dmc_mtdt <- read_csv(file.path(depmapDataDir, "Model.csv"))

# Load first few columns of Chronos data to extract which models are screened
dep <- read_csv(pipe(paste0("cut -d',' -f1,2,3,4,5 ", file.path(depmapDataDir, "CRISPRGeneEffect.csv"))))

colnames(dep)[1] <- "ModelID"

```

## Organize DepMap data

```{r}

# Define & annotate damaging mutations
dmc_damaging_mut <- c("frameshift_variant", "splice_acceptor_variant", "splice_donor_variant", "start_lost", "stop_gained")

dmc_mut %<>% left_join(select(dmc_mtdt, ModelID, OncotreeLineage, OncotreePrimaryDisease, ModelType), by = "ModelID") %>%
                filter(ModelType == "Cell Line" & ModelID %in% dep$ModelID) %>%
                mutate(Damaging = ifelse(grepl(paste(dmc_damaging_mut, collapse = "|"), VariantInfo), 1, 0),
                        ProteinChange = case_when(is.na(ProteinChange) & grepl("splice", VariantInfo) ~ "Splice_Site", .default = ProteinChange))

# Calculate number of models with each mutation
dmc_gene_mut_summ <- dmc_mut %>% group_by(HugoSymbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                                    summarise(DNAChange = paste(unique(DNAChange), collapse = ";"), num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = length(unique(ModelID))) %>%
                                    ungroup() %>%
                                    mutate(DNAChange = gsub("NA;", "", DNAChange)) %>%
                                    arrange(desc(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation))

# Bin damaging mutations and calculate number of models with each mutation
tmp_dmc_dam <- dmc_mut %>% filter(Damaging == 1) %>%
                        mutate(orig_ProteinChange = ProteinChange,
                               ProteinChange = "Damaging_Mutation") %>%
                        group_by(HugoSymbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                        summarise(all_damaging_mut_ProteinChange = paste(unique(orig_ProteinChange), collapse = ";"),
                                  all_damaging_mut_DNAChange = paste(unique(DNAChange), collapse = ";"),
                                  num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = length(unique(ModelID))) %>%
                        ungroup()

tmp_dmc_mut <- dmc_mut %>% filter(Damaging != 1) %>%
                        group_by(HugoSymbol, ProteinChange) %>%
                        summarise(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = length(unique(ModelID))) %>%
                        ungroup()

dmc_gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ <- bind_rows(tmp_dmc_dam, tmp_dmc_mut) %>%
                                    arrange(desc(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation))

rm("tmp_dmc_dam", "tmp_dmc_mut")

```

## Add DepMap model numbers to TCGA data

```{r}

gene_mut_summ %<>% left_join(select(dmc_gene_mut_summ, Hugo_Symbol = HugoSymbol, ProteinChange, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation),
                             by = c("Hugo_Symbol", "ProteinChange")) %>%
                    mutate(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = case_when(is.na(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation) ~ 0, .default = num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)) %>%
                    select(ProjectID, ProjectName, GeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange, all_HGVSc,
                           num_patients_with_mutation, num_patients, pct_patients_with_mutation, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)

gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ %<>% left_join(select(dmc_gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ, Hugo_Symbol = HugoSymbol, ProteinChange, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation),
                                          by = c("Hugo_Symbol", "ProteinChange")) %>%
                    mutate(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = case_when(is.na(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation) ~ 0, .default = num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)) %>%
                    select(ProjectID, ProjectName, GeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange, all_damaging_mut_ProteinChange, all_HGVSc,
                           num_patients_with_mutation, num_patients, pct_patients_with_mutation, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)

pancan_gene_mut_summ %<>% left_join(select(dmc_gene_mut_summ, Hugo_Symbol = HugoSymbol, ProteinChange, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation),
                                    by = c("Hugo_Symbol", "ProteinChange")) %>%
                            mutate(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = case_when(is.na(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation) ~ 0, .default = num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)) %>%
                            select(ProjectID, ProjectName, GeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange, all_HGVSc,
                                   num_patients_with_mutation, num_patients, pct_patients_with_mutation, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)

pancan_gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ %<>% left_join(select(dmc_gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ, Hugo_Symbol = HugoSymbol, ProteinChange, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation),
                                                    by = c("Hugo_Symbol", "ProteinChange")) %>%
                                        mutate(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation = case_when(is.na(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation) ~ 0, .default = num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)) %>%
                                        select(ProjectID, ProjectName, GeneSymbol = Hugo_Symbol, ProteinChange, all_damaging_mut_ProteinChange, all_HGVSc,
                                               num_patients_with_mutation, num_patients, pct_patients_with_mutation, num_DepMap_models_with_mutation)

# Save output
write_tsv(gene_mut_summ, "out/summary_of_mutations_in_TCGA_and_DepMap.txt")
write_tsv(gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ, "out/summary_of_mutations_in_TCGA_and_DepMap_damaging_mutations_binned.txt")

```

## Find prevalent lesions that are underrepresented in DepMap

```{r}

# List known cancer driver genes to avoid
known_genes <- c("KRAS", "BRAF", "EGFR", "IDH1", "APC", "CDKN2A", "CDKN2B", "FBXW7", "TP53", "PIK3CA", "ATRX", "PTEN")

gene_mut_UR <- gene_mut_summ %>% filter(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation < 10 & !GeneSymbol %in% known_genes)

gene_mut_bin_damaging_UR <- gene_mut_bin_damaging_summ %>% filter(num_DepMap_models_with_mutation < 10 & !GeneSymbol %in% known_genes)

```
